name: pharmacy-screen-promo-template
description: Pharmacy Screen Promo Template: one-command deploy to our Firebase test environment (rob-ph-demos) or to the retailer's AWS account (aws/), and the deploy checks.

scripts.check:all: node --test test/*.test.mjs && npm --prefix pharmacy-screen test && npm --prefix pharmacy-screen/config-api test && npm --prefix pharmacy-screen/ph-proxy test && npm --prefix pharmacy-screen/seed test
scripts.check:aws: npm --prefix aws ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix aws test && npm --prefix aws run test:ui
